constraints: Invisible elements are exported (with the corresponding attribute); deleted elements are never exported.
Generates the same output as the Export > Structure definition to XML/HTML file... menu commands.
xml format output is validated against the base_core.dtd/common.dtd files shipped in the DTD folder next to the 4D application; it can be re-imported via IMPORT STRUCTURE.
html format output references an external resources folder (pictures, CSS) that must be reused/created alongside the saved HTML page.

overloadMerges.note: Fixed 'exportedStructure' direction to 'out' (draft defaulted to 'in'); the parameter table marks it with col2 '←' as the variable that receives the exported definition.

params.name: exportedStructure
params.description: Receives the exported 4D database structure definition (XML or HTML, per format)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Exports the current database's structure definition (tables, fields, indexes, relations, and their attributes) into a Text variable, as XML or HTML.
